name: My Show
tagline: One sentence on what the show is and who it's for.
signoff: Alright. That's it, that's the pod.

episode_types.name: Digest
episode_types.trigger: A batch of new material arrives (a day or week of newsletters, articles, saved links). Recurring.
rules: One host brought everything and leads every segment; the other is the audience proxy.
Group the batch into 3-6 themed stories; skip anything that is only a passing mention.

episode_types.name: Deep dive
episode_types.trigger: A subject has accumulated enough material to cover properly (you have read enough on it, or your notes on it are mature). Triggered, not scheduled.
rules: Intern format: open, intern with lead host, intern with other host, close.
Go deeper, not louder: if the subject appeared in a digest, never replay those beats.
Apply your eligibility rules (below) before drafting.

episode_types.name: Single-subject explainer or debate
episode_types.trigger: One primary source (a report, paper, bill, filing, long article) deserves its own episode.
rules: The intern carries the source's facts and takes no side; the hosts argue from them.
Steelman before you rebut; close on the real crux.

eligibility_rules: Replace with your own, e.g. 'no dedicated episodes about a specific person or company'.

_notes.mode: conversation = two friends riffing on the material; explainer = one host walks the other through it; debate = two hosts with opposing priors who steelman each other.
_notes.intern_enabled: true adds a third voice who carries the source material to the hosts. Needs the Gemini renderer (included).
_notes.voices: Any Gemini prebuilt voice name. Browse them at https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/speech-generation
_notes.target_words: [min, max]. About 150 words per minute of audio.
_notes.episode_types: Presets. Keep, rename, edit or delete them. See SPEC/episode-types.md. Rotation is computed from archived payloads by scripts/rotation.py.
_notes.spines: Ids for the spine menu in SPEC/style-guide.md; rotation.py avoids the last few used.
